bundle.shortDescription: Turn your phone into a customizable macro controller for your Windows PC over local Wi-Fi.
bundle.longDescription: LuminaDeck Studio pairs with the LuminaDeck mobile app to deliver a zero-latency, local-only macro deck: drag launch-ready tiles into your phone's grid, bind keyboard/media/Discord shortcuts, or auto-switch profiles when specific apps come to the foreground. No cloud relay; QR-paired local control.
